title.en: The Diesel 60 Order Includes Kawasaki Double Pump 100 and No Aggregate Cell
title.zh: 柴油60的订单包含川崎双泵 100，并且没有骨料格

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Diesel 60 at 6105 / 144 kW, 35 m³/h, Kawasaki double pump 100 and 3500 kg. Aggregate size is not printed. LZ-60 is not this line.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油60印成 6105 / 144 kW、35 m³/h、川崎双泵 100、3500 kg。骨料粒径未印。LZ-60 不是这一行。

h1.en: Write the Diesel 60 Hydraulic-Pump Line as Printed
h1.zh: 按印出的文字写柴油60的液压泵行

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132 as 6105 / 144 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, 150 m / 350 m, Kawasaki double pump 100, 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm and 3500 kg. The page states that aggregate size is not printed. The order can repeat “Kawasaki double pump 100” because that cell exists. It cannot repeat an aggregate size. LZ-60 shares the model string and prints a different hydraulic description by omitting this exact “double pump 100” line, with 145 kW and 50 m³/h. Inquire on [/en/contact/](/en/contact/) with the Diesel 60 path.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）把柴油60 / HBT60-13.132 印成 6105 / 144 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、150 m / 350 m、川崎双泵 100、4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm、3500 kg。该页写明未印骨料粒径。订单可以重复“川崎双泵 100”，因为这一格存在。它不能重复一个骨料粒径。LZ-60 共享型号字符串，功率是 145 kW、输送量 50 m³/h，并没有把这句“双泵 100”印成自己的格子。请带柴油60路径在 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/) 询盘。

body.en: Do not round it to LZ-60’s 145 kW. The output would change with it, from 35 m³/h to 50 m³/h.
body.zh: 不要把它四舍五入成 LZ-60 的 145 kW。输送量会跟着从 35 m³/h 变成 50 m³/h。

heading.en: Send stone as a site fact

body.en: Because the cell is blank, your measured maximum is the only stone figure in the inquiry. Label it as measured, not as a catalogue cell.
body.zh: 因为格子是空的，询盘里唯一的石子数字是你的实测最大值。把它标成实测，而不是目录格。

body.en: 3500 kg is weight. Ask Xingtai for money figures.
body.zh: 3500 kg 是重量。金额问邢台。

answer.en: Not on Diesel 60. LZ-60 prints 100 / 125 mm.
